summary: Reviewed the actual six Archive Engine PNG captures, each covering qids 1–24 including final q24. Desktop and mobile exam/solution/answer layouts show all items; the targeted repaired q2, q10 and q13 display with their source-backed diagrams and labels. No clipping, horizontal overflow, malformed MathJax, missing image decode, page errors, or equation-flow rendering defects were observed. Mobile full-page captures were opened at original resolution and checked by item; q24 is present at the bottom in all six cases.
